title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the Role:**
 We’re looking for a Product Engineer who works at the intersection of product thinking, engineering craft, and agentic AI.
   

  

 This isn’t about picking up tickets. It’s about shaping problems, testing ideas, building solutions, and measuring real impact.
   

  

 You’ll help move our engineering organisation toward a modern product operating model, where discovery comes before delivery, evidence guides decisions, and outcomes matter more than output.
   

  

**What you will do:**
* Own complex product problems end to end, from discovery and solution shaping through delivery, release, measurement, and iteration
* Work with product, business, operations, and engineering stakeholders to understand problems, define success, and make informed trade\-offs
* Run discovery activities including research, technical spikes, prototypes, and assumption testing, with clear go or no\-go recommendations
* Influence backlog and roadmap decisions using evidence rather than simply delivering prioritised work
* Design, build, test, and operate robust solutions across modern and legacy platforms using C\#, ASP.NET Core, Vue, APIs, and supporting services
* Use CI/CD practices in Azure DevOps to release safely, troubleshoot issues, and learn from production.
* Apply and evolve the use of agentic tools such as Cursor, Claude, and similar technologies across discovery, development, and review
* Build and validate agentic solutions and AI\-assisted workflows, ensuring they deliver real value before scaling
* Identify where agentic capabilities belong in customer\-facing products, internal operations, or engineering workflows, and validate whether they create real value before scaling them
* Collaborate with peers to raise the bar in discovery, outcome ownership, technical craft, and responsible AI\-assisted development
* Challenge feature\-factory behaviours and help teams move toward sharper problem framing, smaller bets, and clearer evidence of impact


**What makes you a strong fit:**
* 3\+ years’ experience in software development
* Proven ability to own outcomes, not just deliver code
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and shaping work early
* Strong engineering fundamentals including C\#, APIs, testing, CI/CD, and production support
* Experience balancing speed of learning with production quality
* Hands on experience using AI in your workflow, with an understanding of agentic systems beyond basic code generation
* Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non technical stakeholders
* A collaborative mindset with a focus on coaching, pairing, and shared learning


**This isn't your typical engineering role:**
 This isn’t a traditional senior developer role where success is measured by implementing specifications and moving on to the next ticket.
   

  

 It’s not a role where product discovery happens elsewhere and engineering begins only once the answers are fully formed.
   

  

 And it’s not a role where AI is treated as a novelty, a shortcut, or a substitute for engineering judgement.
   

  

*Instead, we’re looking for someone who brings together
 **product curiosity, technical depth, and agentic leverage,** 
 and someone who helps teams learn faster, make better decisions, and consistently build higher\-quality outcomes.*
**Technology and practices:**
 Our current environment includes:
   

  

* C\#, ASP.NET Core, Vue, APIs, and service integration patterns.
* Legacy and modern platforms that require pragmatic technical judgement.
* Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, release troubleshooting, monitoring, and operational follow\-through.
* Agentic coding and exploration tools such as Cursor and Claude.


 The stack matters, but it is not the centre of the role. The centre of the role is using engineering to discover and deliver measurable product outcomes.
   

  

**How you’ll drive better outcomes:**
 You’ll help define what great product engineering looks like in practice, raising the bar for problem framing, deepening discovery, shaping smaller, better\-informed bets, improving delivery confidence, using AI with intent, and holding a high standard for post\-release impact.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a senior role that brings together product judgement, agentic experimentation, coaching, and real accountability for outcomes, this is that role.
   

  

**Requirements:**
* 12\+ months’ experience developing commercial agentic workflow solutions
* Understanding of product operating models is preferred


**What we offer:**
* Referral Bonus \- Refer people from your professional network and receive a bonus if they are successfully recruited.
* Career Development \- Access experienced professionals across Residential, Core Commercial, Residential Development, Middle Markets, Agribusiness and more. We also provide leadership training and free access to LinkedIn Learning to support your leadership or specialist development.
* Paid Parental Leave \- Receive paid leave to spend quality time at home with your child.
* Novated Leasing Options \- Lease a vehicle through our flexible novated leasing program.
* Work Life Balance \- Flexible working arrangements designed to suit your lifestyle.
* Health Benefits \- Our partnership with Medibank means you are eligible for exclusive employee discounts.
* Onboarding and Training \- Comprehensive company induction and ongoing training to support your success.
* Rewards and Recognition \- Be recognised for your contribution through our Reward and Recognition program, including annual awards, service recognition and more.
* Support When You Need It \- Access confidential support at any time through Intellect, our mental health and wellbeing platform.


**Inclusion at Opteon:**
 Opteon is committed to cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and connectedness, where employees are embraced for their unique qualities and valued for their contributions. We encourage applications from everyone, including people living with disability, job seekers of all ages, members of the LGBTIQA\+ community and people from culturally diverse backgrounds, including First Nations Peoples.
   

  

**How to apply:**
 If you are interested, please click the apply button and submit your resume.

description:

* St Kilda Rd Location
* Full Time \| Permanent Position


 At Compare Club, we’re on a mission to make it easier for consumers to navigate household expenses, helping them make the right purchasing decisions while delivering genuine value and peace of mind.
   

  

 As our Junior AI and Automation Specialist, you’ll write the code behind Compare Club's AI agents, workflows, and integrations. Working under the guidance of our Tech Lead, you will take well\-scoped designs and turn them into production\-ready automations using platforms like n8n and UiPath.
   

  

 This is an AI\-first development environment. You will use Claude Code as your primary tool, mastering how to direct AI pair\-programmers to build integrations, tools, and MCP servers. If you understand how processes connect, love clean code, and want to ship modern AI tools daily, this role is for you.
   

  

**Key Accountabilities \& Responsibilities**
* Workflow Development: Take well\-scoped blueprints from our Tech Lead, Business Analyst, and business stakeholders and turn them into working, high\-quality automation (workflows, integrations, agent tools, and MCP servers).
* Hands\-on Coding: Write clean, well\-structured, and tested code in our primary languages, leveraging Claude Code to accelerate your output.
* Run \& Support: Monitor your automations in production, proactively respond when things break, fix the root causes, and support the internal teams who rely on them.
* Code Quality \& Review: Follow team standards for Git version control, testing, and documentation. Actively participate in code reviews to sharpen your skills with each build.
* Knowledge Capture: Document your builds clearly so both our human team and our AI tools can easily reference, extend, and maintain them.


 What You Bring to the Role We value strong foundational coding ability, a grasp of workflows, and an eagerness to learn over a long AI track record.
   

  

* Workflow Intuition: You can look at a process, see where the hand\-offs and decision points are, and understand how to translate that into an automated system.
* Solid Coding Fundamentals: A strong grounding in at least one general\-purpose programming language (Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript). You understand Git and are comfortable on the command line.
* Software Basics: A working grasp of APIs, data structures, and how different web services communicate with each other.
* An AI\-First Mindset: You are excited to use Claude Code as your primary development tool, directing it effectively and critically reviewing its output.
* Methodical Problem Solving: You test your own work rigorously and take pride in supporting what you ship after it goes live.
* Great Collaboration: Excellent communication skills. You are comfortable reaching out to Tech Leads, BAs, and stakeholders to clarify details rather than guessing or staying stuck.


 Why Join Compare Club?
   

  

* AI\-First Mentorship: You won't just maintain legacy systems. You will be at the forefront of modern software engineering, learning to build with AI to supercharge your career.
* Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy the best of both worlds with our flexible hybrid working model, balancing productive remote work with collaborative team days in our Sydney, Melbourne, or Brisbane offices.

title: Signal Engineer
description:
**About The Role**
 Matilda is Australia's LLM. What ends up in the corpus is what the model learns, so the quality of the data sets the ceiling on the quality of the model.
   

  

 We're hiring a Signal Engineer to own that ceiling. You will build the pipelines that turn massive, messy, raw data into the dataset Matilda trains on. The work is part engineering, part editorial judgment, done in code.
   

  

 A lot of the real gains in frontier models come from the data, and most of that work is underinvested in across the field. It is one of the highest\-leverage places you can spend your time as an engineer.
   

  

**What You'll Work On**
* Pipelines that ingest, clean, dedupe, filter, and score training data at TB to PB scale
* Quality classifiers and heuristics that separate useful data from the rest
* Dataset mixture design and experiments on what actually improves the model
* Tools to explore, sample, and audit what's in the corpus
* Close work with researchers and training engineers so data choices connect to model behaviour


**What We're Looking For**
* Strong engineer. Python, data tooling, distributed processing, clean pipelines.
* High attention to detail. Small errors compound fast at this scale.
* Taste and judgment about what good training data looks like.
* Comfort working with very large, very messy datasets.
* Curiosity about how data shapes model behaviour.
* High learning velocity. You don't need a PhD or prior LLM experience.


**Nice to have**
* Experience with web\-scale corpora or pretraining data pipelines
* Experience working with unstructured text data
* Familiarity with distributed data frameworks (Spark, Ray, or similar)
* Exposure to deduplication, quality classification, or tokenisation


**Note**
 Full\-time role based in Melbourne, working closely with our in\-person team. At this time we are not able to offer visa sponsorship, so applicants must have existing and unrestricted work rights in Australia.

You bring strong role\-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.
   

  

 You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end\-to\-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. **What You’ll Do**

* Partner with product engineering teams to drive security outcomes – such as automation for patching, and development of gateways and other services to decrease risk.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
**About Portable**
 We care about people and the world. We look for areas of social need and policy failure and make transformational change using research, design and technology. Our clients are as passionate as we are, working in government agencies, nonprofit organisations and socially\-minded businesses.
   

  

 There are currently 65\+ of us working as researchers, strategists, designers, technologists and producers from our head office in Collingwood, and remotely from co\-working spaces and homes across Australia.
   

  

 Then there's you.
   

  

**A principal technologist with range**
 This role is part of one of our delivery teams. The work covers multiple projects at once: different clients, different problem spaces, different technology environments. You won't be embedded with a single client long\-term. You'll move across a portfolio of work, going where you're needed and demonstrating excellence in all these areas.
   

  

 That requires genuine adaptability. One week you might be leading architecture decisions on a cloud\-native platform and the next, you're pairing with a mid\-level developer on a tricky integration, or helping shape a proposal. You're comfortable with that kind of context\-switching and even enjoy it.
   

  

 You're past the point of needing to prove yourself technically. What drives you is doing the work properly: building the right thing, making sure the team understands why, and leaving things in better shape than you found them. You can walk into an ambiguous situation, work out what's needed, and get on with it.
   

  

 You also know that good technology consulting isn't only about delivery. You help us win work by being someone clients trust, and by being able to articulate the technical approach clearly when it matters.
   

  

**We are looking for someone who:**
* Is a principal\-level practitioner: technically strong, adaptable across stacks, and able to lead projects independently
* Brings depth in C\#, Python, Typescript, AWS and/or Azure, paired with a technology\-agnostic mindset and willingness to work across open source and Microsoft ecosystems
* Is across AI tooling and applies it actively, both in their own work and to help their team work better
* Has designed and delivered complex systems across multiple projects and industries, from architecture through to production
* Can lead delivery independently: scoping work, managing uncertainty and keeping teams on track
* Communicates clearly with a wide range of stakeholders, in person and in writing, without hiding behind jargon
* Mentors more junior staff through pairing, pull request reviews and direct guidance
* Shares knowledge freely and makes the people around them better
* Helps us grow by contributing to pitches and building client trust


**A week at Portable might look like:**
* Leading architecture and implementation of a new API layer on an AWS\-hosted platform, while reviewing infrastructure decisions on a separate Azure engagement
* Pairing with a mid\-level engineer on a complex integration problem, not just solving it but helping them understand the reasoning
* Reviewing pull requests across a couple of active projects, with feedback that improves both the code and the person who wrote it
* Contributing to a proposal, helping the team frame the technical approach and make the case for why Portable is the right partner
* Running one of our monthly Deep Dive sessions on something you've been working with lately, maybe AI\-assisted development or an architecture pattern worth sharing
* Sprint planning with a producer, writing up tickets in Jira, and thinking about how to structure the work so junior developers get some real learning opportunities


**How we pay and support our team**
 The salary range for this role is $138,000 to $190,000 plus superannuation.
   

  

 Here's what else comes with working at Portable:
   

  

* **Meaningful work:** 
 we take on projects aimed at making a real difference in areas like mental health, social justice and accessibility
* **Flexible working:** 
 remote and hybrid options (up to 2 days per week), flexible hours, and personalised start/finish times
* **Extra leave:** 
 bonus annual leave based on tenure, the option to buy more leave, paid volunteering leave, and paid mental health days with no explanation required
* **Professional development:** 
 a $2,000 annual allowance plus two working days, structured career pathways, twice\-yearly salary reviews, and access to our Leadership Development programs
* **Wellbeing support:** 
 up to 4 counselling sessions per year through our EAP with The Mindroom, covering general wellbeing, career planning and life's challenges
* **Financial benefits:** 
 profit\-sharing bonus, employee share plan options and salary sacrificing
* **Family\-friendly:** 
 enhanced parental leave and flexible arrangements around things like school drop\-offs and caring for sick family members


**How to apply**
 We are committed to building a diverse and equal team. People from underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

* Your resume

* What's attracted you to this role and why do you think it would be a good fit for you?

title: Join our Data Science & AI Talent Community at CommBank
description:
**What is the Talent Community?**
 At CommBank, we’re always looking for people who put customers first and want to use data and AI to solve meaningful problems at scale. Our recruitment is ongoing and never closes — you can join our Data Science \& AI Talent Community at any time, and we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities as they arise.
   

  

 Roles are typically based in Sydney, Melbourne, Adelaide or Perth, depending on the team, and sit within our Data Science \& AI practice across the Group. Opportunities commonly include Data Scientist, Senior Data Scientist, Chapter Lead/Senior Manager, and Principal Data Scientist roles.
   

  

 As part of our teams, you’ll build commercial, enterprise‑grade AI solutions that improve productivity, strengthen decision‑making and deliver better customer experiences — while ensuring AI is used responsibly, ethically and at scale for the benefit of customers and the broader Australian community.
   

  

**Global AI Leadership \& Partnerships**
 At CommBank, you’ll work at the forefront of applied AI through strategic partnerships with OpenAI and Anthropic, alongside deep collaboration with the global technology ecosystem. Our Seattle Tech Hub embeds our teams with world‑class technology partners to accelerate capability and deliver real‑world generative and agentic AI solutions at scale. This leadership has been recognised globally, with CommBank ranked \#4 worldwide in the 2025 Evident AI Index for AI maturity.
   

  

**Who We’re Looking For**
 At CommBank, our values of
 **Care, Courage and Commitment** 
 guide everything we do – for our customers, our communities and each other. Within Data Science \& AI, these values come to life through responsible use of data, ethical AI, and decisions that balance innovation with trust and impact.
   

  

 We’re building a community of Data Scientists who share these values – people who combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial thinking, leadership capability and purpose. Whether you’re actively looking for your next role or planning a future move, we’d love to hear from people who:
   

  

* Show care by putting customers and community at the heart of data‑driven solutions – acting with integrity, accountability and an ethical mindset focused on customer outcomes, colleagues and key stakeholders.
* Demonstrate courage through curiosity and sound judgement – excited by tackling new and complex business problems in AI, evolving existing products and capabilities, challenging assumptions and positively influencing senior stakeholders through evidence‑based insight. This includes a strong, curiosity‑led approach to questioning, validating and solving problems using mathematics, statistics and models, and feeling empowered to share thought leadership and problem‑solving ideas in a growing environment that addresses real‑world challenges impacting millions of customers across Australia.
* Live commitment by investing in continuous learning and craft excellence – bringing deep, hands‑on expertise in Artificial Intelligence and Large Language Models (LLMs), with a proven track record of designing, building and delivering end‑to‑end AI capabilities for business stakeholders. This includes strong practical experience implementing Generative AI and agentic and multi‑agent systems, using modern frameworks and tooling such as Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, LangGraph and the OpenAI Responses API, as well as applying a combination of commercial and technical AI models to deliver solutions that create strategic value.
* Thrive in collaborative environments – working closely with product, engineering and business teams, curious enough to solve real‑world problems, and collaborative in how you design, test and scale AI solutions across the organisation.
* Feel energised working autonomously and taking ownership – as a self‑motivated, driven leader of work who can effectively collaborate with, support and uplift teams of Data Scientists and AI specialists to deliver high‑quality, scalable outcomes.
* Connect purpose with impact – contributing to and leading transformational AI initiatives that improve customer outcomes, build trust, and support CommBank’s role in Australia’s long‑term financial wellbeing.


**What We Offer**
* Flexible opportunities with balance and impact – Enjoy hybrid working that supports both your career and lifestyle, while delivering work that genuinely matters.
* Deepen your expertise – Work with modern data and AI platforms, tools and frameworks, and tackle complex, high‑impact problems at enterprise scale.
* Grow your career – Join a strong data science community with clear technical and leadership pathways, mentoring opportunities, and the ability to move across domains and roles.
* Industry‑leading employee experiences, benefit packages and discounts
* An inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive We welcome and encourage applications from Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander peoples, supported by our dedicated Indigenous Careers Team. You’ll also have access to networks that celebrate diversity, foster belonging, and support accessibility requirements and workplace adjustments.


**How The Process Works**
* Apply anytime \- Apply using the link, tell us your availability and preferred locations.
* Talent Acquisition review \- If online assessments are successful, our recruitment team will review your experience and may connect with you to assess suitability for current and future Data Science opportunities at CommBank.
* Talent Community membership \- If successful, we’ll confirm your membership in our Talent Community for ongoing engagement for upcoming roles. As an active member, you can move quickly from expressing interest to interview, without needing to re‑apply.
* Get matched \- We’ll reach out when a suitable role opens.

 We’re on a mission to empower anyone to curate, grow, and monetize their digital universe. We created the “link in bio” category — and we’re just getting started. From creators, artists, and entrepreneurs to global brands, we’re redefining how people connect with their communities, showcase their content and promote products — all in one link.

 We're a global, diverse team spread across continents with offices in London, Los Angeles, Melbourne, and San Francisco. We work together flexibly and you can choose the setup that works best for you: fully remote or a hybrid mix of office and home.

Our culture is family\-friendly and Zoom\-casual where kids, pets, and delivery drivers are welcome.

 At Linktree, we believe in promoting a culture that celebrates unique backgrounds, talents, and experiences, and we’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are creating an inclusive workplace where every individual feels valued, respected, and has equal opportunities to thrive. We aim to foster a diverse and inclusive environment where all team members have a sense of belonging. Linktree welcomes all people regardless of sex, gender identity, race, ethnicity, disability, pregnancy, age, or other lived experience. If you require accommodations to fully participate in our opportunities, please don't hesitate to reach us at talent@linktr.ee – your needs are important to us.

title: Founding ML Engineer
description:
**About Us** 




  





 Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private, and always available on your device.
 



 We're building the infrastructure for the next generation of on\-device AI, from silicon\-level optimizations to distributed inference systems.
 



  





 We're working on hard problems at the intersection of inference efficiency, model intelligence, and autonomous research.
 



  





  





**The Role** 




  





 We're looking for a Founding ML Engineer to work at the frontier of on\-device AI. This role is for someone who lives at the intersection of systems engineering and machine learning, turning state\-of\-the\-art research into hyper\-optimized, production\-ready infrastructure.
 



  





 You'll have significant ownership over our entire inference stack and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes.
 



  





  





**What You'll Work On** 




  




* Inference engine development: building and scaling our custom inference engine, handling everything from weight loading and KV\-cache management to efficient request scheduling
* Cross\-platform silicon optimization: writing and tuning custom kernels and leveraging hardware\-specific instructions to squeeze maximum performance out of diverse architectures, including Apple Silicon, NVIDIA, AMD, Snapdragon, and other edge platforms
* Systems architecture: developing robust, low\-latency serving runtimes in C\+\+ to manage model routing, continuous batching, and novel decoding strategies under strict thermal and memory constraints
* Performance profiling: identifying and eliminating bottlenecks across the entire stack, from memory bandwidth ceilings to kernel interleaving



  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  




* 3\+ years of experience in ML engineering or systems programming (Rust, C/C\+\+), with a strong track record of building performance\-critical software
* Expertise in GPU programming and hardware optimization across various platforms (CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Triton, or similar)
* Solid understanding of modern LLM architectures, including parsing formats and implementing optimization techniques (quantization, speculative decoding, etc.)
* A strong sense of ownership and autonomy: the ability to take ambiguous architectural challenges and drive them from research translation directly into production\-ready infrastructure
* Good communication: the ability to explain complex architectural decisions simply, give honest feedback, and document systems cleanly



  





  





**Nice to Have** 




  




* Familiarity with ML compilers (torch.compile, custom operators)
* Experience with low\-precision inference (INT8/FP8/FP4\)
* Knowledge of Edge LLMOps



  





  





**What We Offer** 




  




* Founding team equity and strong base salary
* Direct influence on technical direction: your ideas will shape the roadmap
* Work on genuinely hard problems that haven't been solved yet
* Small team, fast iteration, low bureaucracy



  





  





**Location** 




  




* The team is based in Melbourne and Berlin and works in\-person from the office most days. We require strong written and spoken English, since the team collaborates across time zones.

 At Fusion5, you'll be the engineer who makes that difference for Australian enterprise clients. * Azure DevOps

 Production AI systems for real enterprise clients \- not internal experiments or proof of concepts that go nowhere.

 Work at the cutting edge of Azure AI Foundry, Copilot, and the full Microsoft AI stack with direct access to Microsoft resources.

 Tight delivery squads where your technical decisions actually matter \- not a large team where your work disappears into the machine.

 Clear progression toward Principal Engineer and Solution Architect roles as the AI practice scales.

 Certification support, conference access, and time to experiment. We need you to stay current and we support you in doing it.

 Australian enterprises are making real decisions about AI right now \- not planning to, not experimenting in isolation, but committing investment and staking business outcomes on it. title: Principal Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Allexive.** 




 Most companies have done an AI workshop or training series. They've got a pilot in flight that nobody's quite sure how to scale. They are AI\-aware, and stuck.
 



  





 Allexive is the AI transformation arm of the Overdose Group. We turn AI\-aware organisations into AI\-operational ones, working with mid\-market and enterprise clients across NZ and Australia by shipping working systems.
 



  





 The work spans three altitudes:
 



  





**Build** 
 . Production\-grade AI systems shipped into the client's environment. PoC or multi\-phase Build Sprint.
 



  





**AI Platform Implementation.** 
 We stand up a client team's AI operating model from the foundation up: the data layer their agents reason over, the platform in their tenancy, the context architecture their Skills and agents draw from, the starter library of those Skills and agents, and the change management that turns it into how the team works. Converts to monthly retainer.
 



  





**Enterprise AI infrastructure.** 
 We architect the shared AI plane the rest of a client's strategy runs on: MCP gateway, shared controls, agentic commerce protocols, vendor selection, phased build roadmap to capital committee.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 The pipeline is outpacing capacity, and the technical surface area is widening across all three altitudes above.
 



  





 We're looking for a Principal Applied AI Architect to help set the technical direction of the business as we scale into new markets and new services.
 



  





 This is not a strategy\-only role. It is not a pure engineering role either.
 



  





 Day to day, that means taking a top\-line technical seat on client engagements: leading discovery, shaping solution architecture, setting technical patterns, reviewing implementation quality, and guiding the engineers and delivery partners around you.
 



  





 You will be the person who can turn a messy client problem into a clear technical path. You will know what should be built, what should not be built, what risks need to be called out, and where the team needs to go deeper.
 



  





 You will also need to stay close enough to the build to be useful. That means getting hands\-on when required: prototyping, pressure\-testing patterns, unblocking spiky technical problems, reviewing code or architecture, and proving what is possible before a team scales it.
 



  





**Job Requirements** 



* **Applied AI Architecture Background:** 
 Designed and delivered real Generative AI systems into mid\-market or enterprise environments. Not demos. Not slideware.

 You do not need to be the main engineer on every build, but you must be able to prototype, review, challenge, debug, and unblock technical work when required.

 Hands\-on with Google ADK, Microsoft MAF, Claude Agents SDK, or equivalent agentic development frameworks. Two or more is a strong signal.

 Tool use, prompt caching, structured outputs, MCP architecture, RAG patterns, context engineering, agent orchestration, and workflow integration.

 Evals, observability, prompt versioning, safety patterns, cost and latency optimisation, model selection, and production monitoring.
* **Enterprise AI Infrastructure:** 
 Understands MCP gateway patterns, agentic protocols, identity, permissions, auditability, security boundaries, and how AI systems operate at scale inside real organisations.
* **Core Technical Stack:** 
 Strong enough in TypeScript/Node or Python to work directly with engineering teams. Cloud\-fluent across AWS, GCP, or Azure, with AWS preferred.
* **Solution Architecture:** 
 Can translate business problems into technical architecture, delivery phases, risk trade\-offs, implementation options, and clear recommendations.
* **Professional Services:** 
 Delivered across industries with enterprise clients. Commercially aware, delivery\-aware, and knows when to flag scope drift before it becomes a problem.
* **Communication:** 
 Confidently leads senior stakeholder forums, writes with clarity under pressure, and challenges C\-Suite constructively without damaging key relationships.



  





**Even better if:** 



* Public technical writing, conference talks, open\-source contributions, or visible work in applied AI, agents, automation, enterprise architecture, or AI platform implementation.



  





 If you don’t tick every single box but you are an experienced
 **AI Architect, AI Engineer, or technical leader working deeply in applied AI** 
 , we’d still love to hear from you.
 



  





**Job Responsibilities** 



* **Solution Architecture and Delivery Direction (50%):** 
 Lead the technical shape of engagements across all three altitudes: Build, AI Platform Implementation, and Enterprise AI Infrastructure. description:
**Position Overview**
 We're accesso Intelligence (powered by Dexibit). 🦖 🎢 🐅 🗼 🖼️ 🎡 🏟️
   

  

 accesso Intelligence is the intelligence layer for the business of fun — serving iconic visitor attractions around the world. Not just data, but AI that understands how attractions actually work, helping teams make insightful decisions then act on them: getting more visitors through the door, spending, engaging, leaving happily and returning loyally, with efficiency.
   

  

 With 25 years of deep industry experience behind us and Dexibit's AI pedigree inside us, you get the best of both worlds: startup culture close to the ground up, with the scale of a listed company behind you.
   

  

**What We Build**
 accesso Intelligence sits on top of the world's richest cross\-vendor dataset for visitor attractions — integrating with 100\+ industry source systems across ticketing, F\&B, retail, queuing, CRM, operations and more. That data foundation is what makes everything else possible: the conversational insight, the forecasting, the benchmarking, the AI.
   

  

**Where You Fit**
 We're looking for a Data Implementation Engineer to own the technical delivery of accesso Intelligence integrations, then executing that pattern reliably and at volume across our customer base. You’ll be building upon, and maintaining, our class\-leading data platform.
   

  

 What makes this role distinct is the combination of technical execution with genuine understanding of how attractions actually operate commercially. A revenue share arrangement between a venue and an operating partner, a multi\-operator ticketing setup, a seasonal membership model with complex redemption logic — these aren't edge cases, they're the norm. Getting the data right means understanding the business behind it.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Auckland based, hybrid (\~3 days in our Parnell office / optionally \~2 at home)
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 VP, accesso Intelligence
   

  

**Travel** 
 ✈️
 **Requirement:** 
 None
   

  

**What You'll Be Working On**
* Establish the integration patterns. Work with the data engineering team to define how accesso Intelligence connects to each accesso product. Data model, transformation logic, semantic mapping, quality thresholds. This is foundational work you'll do once per product (and refine over time) rather than reinvent per customer.
* Scale and maintain across customers. Onboard new customers onto each integration — configuring per venue, validating data integrity against our acceptance criteria. Then own the ongoing health: change requests, configuration updates, and diagnosis when something breaks or drifts.
* Build derived datasets and transformations. Beyond raw integration, you'll help build the derived datasets, transformations and semantic mapping that turn source data into meaningful, analytics\-ready inputs — the layer between what a system outputs and what accesso Intelligence needs to deliver insight.
* Close the feedback loop into accesso. You'll be the eyes and ears of integration reality. We all want to find the global optima. Sometimes that means feedback into the product and engineering teams to shine a light on opportunities and future use cases.
* Work directly with customers on data. You'll engage with customer technical and operational contacts through onboarding and beyond — handling data queries, managing expectations on timelines and data quality, and translating between what customers have and what the platform needs.


**What You Bring To The Role**
* You're fluent in Python and SQL, comfortable with data platforms and transformation tools, and have experience building and maintaining integrations with APIs and third\-party systems. Our stack runs on DuckDB and MotherDuck — you don't need prior experience with them, but you should be the kind of person who finds that interesting rather than a detour from the tools you'd rather be using.

title: Senior Artificial Intelligence Developer
description:
**Te whiwhinga mahi \| The opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Artificial Intelligence Developer who brings a strong combination of machine learning expertise and software engineering capability to design and deliver practical, AI‑enabled tools that support engineering and technical teams across Beca. This is a hands‑on role suited to someone who is equally comfortable building and deploying production\-grade software as they are developing and applying machine learning models, and who is ready to broaden their scope, take on more responsibility, and step into a more senior delivery role.
   

  

 You’ll work closely with engineering business users, digital specialists, and data teams to iterate on high\-value use cases and transform them into scalable, production\-ready solutions. Success in this role requires the ability to bridge the gap between experimentation and implementation—taking machine learning concepts and embedding them into robust, maintainable software systems. Your work will span areas such as document intelligence, engineering automation, computer vision, machine learning, AI\-augmented verification, and compliance support, giving you exposure to a wide range of real‑world engineering problems and applied AI use cases.
   

  

 You will operate in a highly agile environment, often working across multiple projects simultaneously and adopting a fail\-fast, iterative approach. You’ll apply the right tools and frameworks for each use case, ranging from Python (SciKit\-learn and broader ML libraries) through to C\# and agent frameworks, as well as Power BI, low\-code and pro\-code environments such as Microsoft Foundry and Copilot Studio. Critically, this role requires someone who can engineer end\-to\-end solutions—from data handling and model development through to software integration, deployment, and lifecycle management. The problems you’ll work on are as diverse as the toolset, including unstructured data extraction and retrieval, automation workflows, ML model training, AI agents, and more.
   

  

 As you grow in the role, you’ll strengthen your ability to work with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, translating complex machine learning and engineering concepts into clear, usable outcomes. Through this work, you’ll help build and mature Beca’s applied AI capability, while establishing yourself as a well\-rounded AI practitioner with deep expertise across both machine learning and software development, contributing to responsible, real\-world solutions across our business.
   

  

**Ko wai koe \| About you**
 You bring around 5–7 years of experience across both artificial intelligence and software development, giving you a strong foundation to design and deliver end‑to‑end AI solutions. You are confident working across the full lifecycle—from machine learning model development through to building, integrating, and deploying production\-grade software—and are ready to take the next step by tackling more complex, scaled AI applications. You enjoy applying machine learning and AI to practical engineering and technical problems, and are motivated by delivering reliable, real\-world outcomes across areas such as document intelligence, automation, reporting, and compliance support.
   

  

 You have experience contributing to AI solutions from early experimentation through to deployment and continuous improvement, and are confident bridging the gap between data science and software engineering. You enjoy building systems from first principles rather than relying solely on pre\-configured tools, and are comfortable developing AI\-enabled applications that are robust, maintainable, and production\-ready using the appropriate toolkit. You’re increasingly confident taking ownership of larger components or end\-to\-end delivery of solutions.
   

  

 You bring a consulting mindset — collaborative, curious, and outcome\-focused. You work effectively with business users, technical specialists, and stakeholders, helping translate requirements into practical AI solutions and iterating based on feedback. You communicate clearly and are developing confidence in explaining both machine learning concepts and engineering decisions to non\-technical audiences, supporting adoption and trust in new tools across teams.
   

  

 Your background includes hands\-on experience with applied AI techniques such as LLM application development, prompt engineering, structured outputs, and document parsing, alongside exposure to areas like computer vision or domain\-specific data. This is complemented by strong programming capability and software engineering practices, including version control, testing, cloud environments, and CI/CD. With an interest in engineering contexts, you’re motivated to keep learning and apply AI in ways that are ethical, secure, and genuinely useful—contributing to meaningful outcomes for clients, communities, and the built environment through Beca’s consulting network.
   

  

**Ngā āhuatanga kei a mātou \| What we offer**
**A Career With Beca Will Provide You With**
* Professional development opportunities.
* A supportive and caring work environment where you can bring your whole self to work.
* Support with relocation and immigration to suitable applicants.
* Flexible working arrangements to balance your personal / family commitments.
* Opportunities to learn from our industry experts and technical gurus across the Asia Pacific.
* A highly supportive environment of sharing and collaboration.
* Excellent benefits provided to all staff – including discounted health insurance, discounts on gym memberships, and a number of social club events.


 Beca prides itself on supporting a diverse and inclusive culture – open to inputs from creative people of all genders, ethnicity, identity, thought and experiences.

 Beca is one of Asia Pacific’s largest independent advisory, design, and engineering consultancies. After a century of operation, we have grown from a family\-owned business to one of the most progressive, client\-centric professional services consultancies in our region. title: Lead Engineers - Product & Engineering
description:
**About Halter**
 At Halter, we’re on a mission to enable farmers and graziers to run the most productive and sustainable operations. Our customers are using Halter to break free from the time\-intensive constraints of conventional practices. Imagine watching 500 cattle stand up and walk calmly towards their next break? No quad bikes, no dogs, no fences. Just a group of cattle walking at their own pace. People say it looks like magic. Our customers are revolutionizing grazing with Halter. It's changing lives and transforming an industry. People join Halter to do meaningful work. By joining us you’ll be solving challenging problems within a talented team and a culture built for high performance. Our team out\-think, out\-work and out\-care. We’re committed to delivering real change in the world \- this isn’t easy, and in truth, we love that it’s hard.
   

  

 We’re backed to deliver on a mission that matters by Tier 1 investors including Founders Fund, Bessemer Venture Partners, BOND, DCVC, Blackbird, Promus Ventures, Rocket Lab’s Peter Beck and Icehouse ventures.
   

  

 To find out more, visit our LinkedIn \& Instagram.
   

  

 At Halter, we know how much farmers care \- for their animals and their pasture. But the tools they rely on haven’t kept up, and we’re on a mission to change that. Halter helps farmers make smarter decisions \- fast. We reckon good pasture management is the key to more productive and sustainable farms. More grass. Healthier soil. Happier animals. And more time back for the people doing the work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We're looking for
 **Lead Engineers** 
 who perform at the top of the craft. You'll take on the hardest problems, make the calls that matter on the gnarliest design questions, and ship work that the rest of the team learns from. Engineers around you get better because they're working alongside you. We don't mind whether your strengths sit on the frontend, backend, full stack, or on the platform side that gives every other engineer leverage. What matters is that you ship robust, thoughtful work at a level few others can match, and use AI tools well.
   

  

**The kind of problems our teams solve**
**Halter is one system:** 
 hardware, software, and AI, running live on real farms. Our engineering teams own different slices of that system, but the problems all rhyme:
   

  

* Turning thousands of collars and billions of sensor events into a single, calm decision in a farmer's hand.
* Modelling the physical world (animals, pasture, terrain) accurately enough to act on in real time.
* Building mobile and web experiences that hold up at 5am whilst out in a paddock in the rain.
* Designing platforms and pipelines that scale with our incredible pace of growth without the seams showing.
* Engineering against constrained hardware, flaky rural connectivity, and the messiness of the physical world, and shipping with pace despite it.


 Every team here ships software that has to work in a paddock, not just a browser tab.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Take on the hardest problems and ship the work that proves them out.
* Make the architectural calls that matter, then back them up by writing the code.
* Set the standard for thoughtful engineering: clean, observable, easy\-to\-evolve code and systems.
* Support and mentor other engineers through design conversations, code reviews, and generous context sharing.
* Help set the pace and quality bar for engineering at Halter.
* Help evolve our testing strategies, CI/CD workflows, and infrastructure patterns.
* Own the reliability and performance of your domain, especially when things get tricky. Every team owns its services end\-to\-end, with an on\-call rotation.
* Get out on farm. Deep domain knowledge matters, and you'll be expected to develop it.


**You'll be great if you:**
* Have spent years shipping complex systems in production and have the experience (and scars) to show for it.
* Stay calm under pressure, have a low ego, and can rally a team through tough or complex work.
* Think like a product engineer: you care about the customer experience, not just clean code.
* Know how to use AI tools well to lift team output and focus on the harder stuff.
* Have grown other engineers by working alongside them, not by managing them.
* Are comfortable in fast\-moving, ambiguous environments where adaptability beats perfection.
* Have worked in cloud environments. AWS is a bonus.
* A degree in software engineering (or equivalent) is nice to have, but not essential.


**Depending on where you sit on the stack, some of these will land harder than others:**
* Frontend / Mobile: strong UX intuition, modern frontend frameworks (React, React Native a bonus), an eye for performance and polish on real devices.


**Backend:** 
 building and scaling REST APIs, distributed systems, and event\-driven services. Comfort with both relational and non\-relational databases. Node.js, Kotlin, Go, or systems that integrate with hardware/IoT a bonus.
   

  

**Full stack:** 
 all of the above, end to end, across web, mobile, and the services that power them.
   

  

**Platform:** 
 you love building tooling that makes the whole company move faster, including the AI tooling that's reshaping how engineers work. Strong AWS and Terraform at scale, with experience across CI/CD, observability, and on\-call tooling.
   

  

**Our Benefits**
* Delicious snacks and drinks are available for your daily flow.
* Healthy body, healthy mind. We’re partnered with Southern Cross Health Insurance to support your well\-being.
* We offer 6 months of fully paid parental leave for primary caregivers, 4 weeks of fully paid secondary caregiver leave and many other parental benefits that support you and your family.
* Our personal growth is important. Halter offers an annual $1000 self\-development budget to be used for anything that fuels personal growth.
* Our time to recharge is valued, we’re offered wellness leave and unlimited paid annual leave.
* Importantly, we offer an inclusive and attractive remuneration package made up of salary, benefits and an employee stock ownership plan.


**Our Office First Approach**
 There’s a reason you visit your friends in person, live with your family and don’t do dinners over Zoom. Humans are wired for connection. We believe a world\-class, in\-person office culture is the best way for high\-performing teams.
   

  

 Being office first is a core pillar of our culture. We believe in\-person connections are key to driving your own growth, learning, impact, and building genuine long\-lasting relationships. Strong relationships make it easier to disagree, give feedback, and do meaningful and aligned work. We don’t like having heaps of rules or policies, but this means having strong, trusted relationships is critical.
   

  

**We’re office first, not office only.** 
 This means working from the office everyday is our default setting, but we flex when we need to. We have a high\-trust culture, so everyone is trusted to do what’s best for Halter.
   

  

 Our office vibe is something special, it’s hard to describe until you’re here, but people at Halter who have come from fully remote or hybrid companies say they could never go back \- the high energy and spectacular people they are now surrounded by everyday makes work so enjoyable. Your growth, your learning and your impact is truly unlimited here, and a big part of that comes from being together solving problems, innovating, building context, and constantly learning from each other.
   

  

****Join our team****
 Halter is committed to promoting a diverse and inclusive workplace — a place where we can each be ourselves and do the best work of our lives. Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the requirements, women and under\-represented groups of candidates tend to only apply when they meet every requirement. If you think you have what it takes but don’t necessarily tick every requirement on this job description, please still get in touch and apply to Halter. We’d love to chat to see if you’ll be an epic fit!
   

  

 If this opportunity sounds like you, please apply below by sending through your cover letter explaining why you’re excited about this role and working at Halter, along with your CV, and we’ll be in touch!
   

  

 Please also feel free to check out the careers page for more information on working at Halter and don't forget to follow us on LinkedIn \& Instagram.
   

  

****Why our team loves working at Halter:****
* Work that genuinely matters. Every now and again a company comes along that transforms an entire industry and leaves the world in a better place. Our team gets to be part of something truly meaningful, helping farmers improve their livelihoods, spend more time with their families, and build more sustainable operations.
* Spectacular people solving hard problems. Our culture is designed for talented people to do work that changes lives. The team is filled with diverse, kind, and driven people who push each other to do their best work. You'll be thrown into the deep end, tackling complex challenges and building something tangible that solves real problems.
* You'll grow here. Autonomy, mastery, and learning define how we work. You'll have the freedom to work on interesting problems, master new skills, and continuously develop yourself, both through your role and our $1,000 personal growth fund.
* This isn't easy, and we love that it's hard. Working at Halter will be the most rewarding and the most challenging work of your life. We move fast, take bold bets, and work hard to reshape an entire industry. As one team member put it: "Joining Halter is a bit like strapping yourself to a rocket ship, but it's an epic journey to be a part of!"

title: Growth Engineer
description:
**About The Opportunity**
 We're looking for a Growth Engineer to join the First Table team and own the experimentation engine that shapes how diners discover and book.
   

  

 This is a role for someone who thrives on speed — shipping A/B tests, optimising conversion funnels, and rapidly validating ideas across both web and mobile. You won't be building for the sake of it; every experiment has a hypothesis, every result moves the needle.
   

  

 With clear OKRs and a dedicated Conversion \& Growth function, you'll work closely with our Conversion Lead to drive measurable improvements to booking performance, onboarding, and customer experience, across our website and mobile apps.
   

  

 This position can be based remotely from Auckland or at our Queenstown HQ.
   

  

**About Us**
 At First Table, our vision is simple: to be the first place diners go to book a table.
   

  

 Proudly established in Queenstown, New Zealand, where our head office is based, we've been leading the charge in the hospitality tech industry for over a decade, with operations spanning New Zealand, Australia, and the UK.
   

  

 First Table is a dining discovery platform that connects diners to restaurants through their love of food. Through our clever tech, we help restaurants get their night off to a great start and give diners a compelling reason to try somewhere new. From early bird offers to last table reservations, we make discovering and booking great dining experiences fast, easy, and rewarding.
   

  

 At the heart of everything we do are our values: Win\-Win\-Win, Own It, and Grow Together. These guide how we show up for each other, our restaurant partners, and our diners and they're a big part of what makes First Table a great place to work.
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a hands\-on growth engineering role focused on experimentation and conversion, working across our Next.js web platform and React Native / Expo mobile apps using shared React and TypeScript knowledge.
   

  

 If you love shipping fast, learning from real data, and iterating until something works \- you'll feel right at home here.
   

  

 What you'll be doing
   

  

* Build and iterate on customer\-facing experiments across web and app, including A/B tests, onboarding flows, landing pages, and funnel improvements
* Rapidly prototype and validate new customer experiences with a focus on learning speed over polish
* Implement and optimise experiments using GrowthBook or similar experimentation and feature flagging platforms
* Contribute event tracking and analytics instrumentation to measure experiment outcomes and customer behaviour
* Work within our Next.js web and React Native / Expo mobile codebases, writing clean, maintainable TypeScript and React
* Collaborate closely with Product, Design, Analytics, and Engineering to validate hypotheses and ship improvements that stick


 What you'll bring
   

  

* Solid experience in React and TypeScript across web and/or mobile (React Native experience a bonus)
* A genuine interest in conversion optimisation, experimentation, and customer behaviour, not just writing code
* Comfort working in fast\-moving environments where not every experiment becomes a permanent feature
* Familiarity with A/B testing, feature flagging, and analytics tooling
* Strong communication skills and the ability to work autonomously across cross\-functional teams
* An ownership mindset: you care about outcomes, not just output


 Why you'll love working with us
   

  

* Direct impact on the metrics that matter, your experiments shape the customer experience for diners across NZ, AU, and the UK
* High\-autonomy role in a team that values speed, learning, and pragmatism
* Work from our Queenstown HQ (fun office culture, regular social events, 1 WFH day per week) or Auckland, where the team works remotely and connects regularly for collaboration and catch\-ups
* Perks including free First Table bookings, referral incentives, team recognition, and regular opportunities to celebrate wins
* Join a beloved consumer brand that is purpose\-led, award\-winning, and values creativity, collaboration, and growth


 What's next?
   

  

 Ready to run experiments people feel? Apply now.
   

  

 Include your CV and a cover letter, we genuinely read them, so make it count: why First Table, and why you?
   

  

 We're reviewing and progressing applications as they come in, so don't wait to apply.

title: Intermediate Software Engineer

title: AI Developer
description:
Job Description
 



 "Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship."
 



  





 The AI Developer is responsible for developing new AI applications and software including agentic AI applications, analytical solutions and pilot new ideas from incubation to deployment. This role is critical part of Family Dollar’s capability to build our own AI applications inhouse using top of line agent development kits, APIs, software libraries and interface with our vendors and partners to trial their products for fit within Family Dollar’s IT estate, including our cloud environments, digital applications, and our operational systems.

They are adept with generative AI, large language models, and agentic AI frameworks, and bring a working knowledge of MLOps, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), and applied data science. They can take new ideas from incubation through pilot to production, run experiments on their own to validate feasibility, define success metrics, evaluation methodology, and exit criteria at each stage.
 



  





 Principal Duties \& Responsibilities:
 


* Design, build, and deploy production AI applications on Google Cloud Platform, applying machine learning and generative AI techniques to deliver solutions across merchandising, supply chain, store operations, finance, and customer experience.

* Execute experiments to vet emerging AI capabilities and determine their internal product\-market fit.
* Deploy and maintain production\-grade AI agents capable of reasoning, tool\-use, and multi\-step task execution.
* Manage the full lifecycle of your code, from initial prompt engineering and fine\-tuning to CI/CD and real\-time monitoring of agent performance.
* Mentor junior engineers and share knowledge across the AI and Automation team.

**Position Requirements:**



* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 8\+ years of progressive IT experience in large, cross functional teams or projects, preferably in a retail environment.
* Write clean, well\-tested, well\-documented Python code; conduct code reviews; and contribute to internal libraries, templates, and engineering best practices.
* Ability in developing, presenting and communicating technical concepts to varying audiences.
* Possesses a sense of urgency as well as the ability to motivate a team towards achieving results in a dynamic environment
* Experience in retail, supply chain, or large\-scale operational environments within retail systems (POS, ERP, CRM, inventory, supply chain, etc).
* Advanced knowledge of recent GenAI platform advancements from top providers as well as equivalent platforms hyperscalers
* Experienced in responsible AI practices, model governance, and frameworks for evaluating LLM safety and accuracy.
* Contributions to open\-source AI projects or relevant publications.



  





 Family Dollar is an equal opportunity employer and committed to recruiting, hiring, training, and promoting qualified people of all backgrounds, and make all employment decisions without regard to any protected status. We are committed to complying with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: AI & Automation Engineer
description:
D.A. Davidson Companies is an independent, employee\-owned company with a rich history spanning 90 years. We support a friendly, open and supportive culture, and encourage candid communication and productive engagement that make our companies and each of us better. Just as we work to improve our clients’ financial well\-being, we also work to strengthen local communities—and giving back is one of our core values. You can learn more about our company culture and impact in our latest annual report.
   

  

**Summary/Function:**
 We are seeking a Mid\-Level AI and Automation Engineer to develop next\-generation AI capabilities within our Microsoft\-based environment. This role will focus on building intelligent assistants and automated workflows using tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio, Power Automate, and Azure AI Foundry. The ideal candidate will combine software engineering expertise with a passion for leveraging AI to transform business processes in a financial services and wealth management domain. You will work on integrating large language model solutions into enterprise systems, ensuring they are secure, compliant, and deliver real value to end\-users.
   

  

**Qualifications:**
* Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field. 5\+ years of experience in software development, automation engineering, or similar roles
* Microsoft Ecosystem Proficiency: Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Power Automate and related Power Platform tools for workflow automation. Familiarity with M365 Copilot features or similar AI bot/agent development tools (e.g. Azure AI services, cognitive services)
* Programming Skills: Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language (such as Python, C\#, or JavaScript) to extend and customize solutions. Experience building or consuming RESTful APIs and working with data integration
* Cloud \& AI Knowledge: Working knowledge of Azure cloud services and AI/ML frameworks. Ability to deploy applications or automations in a cloud environment and integrate AI APIs (Azure OpenAI, Azure Cognitive Services, etc.)
* DevOps Mindset: Experience with version control (git and Bitbucket) and continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines for software projects. Comfortable using tools like Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to automate build\-test\-deploy processes
* Problem\-Solving \& Communication: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a track record of delivering solutions that meet business needs. Excellent communication skills to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical team members
* Coordination: Align efforts with other lines\-of\-business and functional areas, such as our partners in Operations, Finance, Wealth Management, and more


**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Copilot Studio Expertise: Experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot Studio \- for example, having built or managed AI copilots/agents in a production setting. Knowledge of designing conversation flows, topics, tools, and using Copilot’s advanced features (custom actions, agent\-to\-agent workflows)
* Advanced AI \& ML Skills: Familiarity with large language models beyond basic API usage \- e.g., experience with prompt tuning, deploying LLMs, or implementing retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines with vector databases for domain\-specific Q\&A. Experience with Azure AI Foundry and Azure AI capabilities like document intelligence, computer vision, speech, and more
* Financial Services Experience: Background in financial services or wealth management technology projects. Understanding of industry regulatory requirements (e.g. data privacy, audit, model risk management) and how to design AI solutions that comply with them
* Security \& Compliance Focus: hands\-on experience implementing security, compliance, and responsible AI practices in software. For instance, familiarity with Microsoft’s Responsible AI guidelines, Azure Purview for data governance, or similar tools to control AI use
* Innovation \& Leadership: Demonstrated initiative in previous roles \- maybe you introduced a new automation tool, led a pilot of an AI solution, or actively contributed to AI/automation communities. Microsoft certifications in Azure AI, Power Platform, or related areas would be an advantage, reflecting your commitment to staying current
* Lean and Agile background: Lots of experience working in highly\-iterative development processes. You understand the principles of them but aren’t married to any particular methodology
* Patience: Somebody prepared to deal with the boring and the tough. Every minute of every day in an AI role isn’t always deploying new models and agents. An engineer in this role must also be willing and able to take on things like vendor integration, bug fixing, and other operational and administrative work that comes up day\-to\-day


 The following is required from all associates of D.A. Davidson Companies:
   

  

  

* Commitment to maintain client confidentiality and data security
* Communicate in a clear and service\-oriented manner; use appropriate, professional language and grammar to effectively exchange ideas and information
* Ability to proactively work with both external and internal clients; relate with others in a professional manner to accomplish work responsibilities and objectives
* Ability to maintain regular, predictable attendance

* Integrate Enterprise Data and Systems: Connect AI copilots to enterprise data sources and APIs, enabling context\-rich automation (e.g. integrating Azure AI services or databases with Copilot agents for real\-time information retrieval)
* Apply AI Best Practices: Implement prompt engineering techniques and fine\-tune AI models or prompts to improve the relevance and accuracy of Copilot responses. Utilize Azure OpenAI or similar services to incorporate advanced language AI capabilities when needed
* Ensure Compliance and Security: Build solutions with robust security, privacy, and compliance controls in mind, aligning with corporate policies and industry regulations (financial data protection, responsible AI use, audit logging). Work closely with governance teams to enforce security standards for AI integrations
* DevOps and Monitoring: Develop CI/CD pipelines for deploying and updating AI agents or automation workflows, ensuring smooth rollouts and version control. Set up monitoring and telemetry dashboards to track performance, usage, and quickly address any issues
* Collaboration and Iteration: Work in an Agile team alongside product managers, business analysts, and designers to refine requirements and user stories. Iterate on solutions based on user feedback and analytics, continuously improving the AI assistants’ effectiveness
* Documentation and Training: Document solution designs, workflows, and configurations. Help create user guides or demo sessions to drive adoption of the new AI\-powered tools among employees and stakeholders


**What do we offer:**
 Competitive salary plus excellent benefits and perks including, but not limited to:
   

  

  

* Medical, Dental and Vision
* Company 401(k)and ESOP contribution
* Generous sick, vacation, and maternity/parental leave
* Paid holidays
* Professional Development Opportunities
* Tuition Reimbursement ($15,000 lifetime cap)
* Discounted personal insurance including home, auto and recreational vehicles
* Charitable gift\-matching program
* Davidson Day of Giving \- Our tradition of positively impacting communities in which we live and work

description:
**Summary**
 The AI Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining artificial intelligence and machine learning solutions that support intelligent automation, predictive insight, and advanced analytics across the enterprise. As a hands\-on builder, this role applies software engineering principles to write production\-quality code, build scalable AI systems, including AI Agents and data pipelines, and integrate AI models into new and existing business applications. The AI Engineer collaborates closely with Data Scientists, Data Engineers, ML Ops Engineers, and Platform teams to bring machine learning models from prototype to production. A critical part of this function is to ensure that AI use cases are transitioned from experimentation into reliable, governed, and business\-ready solutions by owning their complete operational readiness. This includes implementing robust observability, defining Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and establishing clear incident response and rollback strategies for all AI services.
   

  

**Job Responsibilities**
 Model Development \& Implementation
   

  

* Write clean, efficient, and well\-documented code to develop and implement machine learning and AI models that support various business use cases.
* Implement data engineering and preprocessing workflows required for model inputs.
* Continuously optimize the performance and scalability of AI applications and models.


 ML Pipelines \& Operations (MLOps)
   

  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable ML pipelines for model training, validation, inference, and deployment.
* Collaborate with ML Ops Engineers to package and deploy models into enterprise systems using established MLOps practices.
* Monitor deployed models in production for performance, data drift, and reliability, and troubleshoot and resolve any issues that arise.
* Establish and own the operational readiness of all AI services by defining and implementing Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for key metrics, such as p50/p95 latency and availability, and creating robust monitoring and alerting for model drift, latency, and error rates.


 Collaboration \& Integration
   

  

* Work closely with Data Scientists to transition experimental models and research prototypes into robust, production\-ready systems.
* Support the integration of AI capabilities into enterprise workflows, applications, and digital platforms.
* Contribute to the documentation and explainability of model outputs to ensure clarity for business stakeholders.


 Governance \& Strategy
   

  

* Ensure all deployed AI systems comply with enterprise governance, fairness, and security standards.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies, such as LLMs and generative AI, to assess their applicability to business problems and drive innovation.


**Preferred Skills/Knowledge/Experience**
 Core Technical \& AI Proficiency
   

  

* Strong coding skills in Python, Java, or C\+\+, including API development and software design
* Deep understanding of core machine learning concepts, including classification, regression, clustering, and deep learning architectures.
* Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks and algorithms (supervised/unsupervised), such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar for building and training complex neural networks.
* Skills in working with LLMs, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, and using frameworks like LangChain and LangGraph to build RAG (Retrieval\-Augmented Generation) systems.
* Handling data wrangling, SQL, data warehousing, and ETL pipelines to prepare data for models


 End\-to\-End ML Model Lifecycle
   

  

* Proven experience in the end\-to\-end model lifecycle: developing, training, and deploying machine learning models from prototype to production.
* Mastery of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques to ensure robust and accurate model performance.
* Demonstrated ability to build and optimize scalable data pipelines for training and evaluating machine learning models.
* Strong knowledge of both SQL and NoSQL databases for querying and managing data for AI applications.


 Software \& MLOps Engineering
   

  

* Solid foundation in software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Hands\-on experience with containerization using Docker and container orchestration with Kubernetes for scalable deployment.
* Expertise in MLOps observability, including model monitoring to track performance and drift, and establishing model/version lineage, telemetry, and traceability.
* Experience implementing advanced testing and deployment strategies, including canary/shadow deployments and comprehensive test suites (unit, integration, adversarial, regression).
* Demonstrated ability to integrate AI models and services into enterprise applications by building and consuming RESTful APIs.


 Cloud \& Infrastructure
   

  

* Proficiency with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, Azure) and its associated AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, Azure ML).
* Experience with big data technologies, such as Apache Spark or similar, for processing large\-scale datasets in a cloud environment.


 Collaboration \& Frontend Development
   

  

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in an Agile development environment.
* Excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Experience with modern frontend JavaScript frameworks such as React, Vue.js, Angular or similar for building user\-facing applications that consume AI models.
* Work on embedding pre\-trained Machine Learning, LLM (Large Language Models) and advance chatbot technologies into workflows to drive automated reasoning and operational efficiencies
* Design, develop and deploy Agentic AI workflows and autonomous AI agents capable of reasoning, interacting with users, and executing actions via system APIs
* System Integration – work closely with other IT teams and architects to ensure chosen technologies avoid redundancy, align with standard frameworks, and fit the organization ecosystem. Contribute to Spec\-Driven Design and Solution Design Documents focusing on modular and reusable code

* Ability to mentor and bring team along with AI\-thinking

**Company Overview** 
  


 At Skild AI, we are building the world's first general purpose robotic intelligence that is robust and adapts to unseen scenarios without failing. We believe massive scale through data\-driven machine learning is the key to unlocking these capabilities for the widespread deployment of robots within society. Our team consists of individuals with varying levels of experience and backgrounds, from new graduates to domain experts. Relevant industry experience is important, but ultimately less so than your demonstrated abilities and attitude. We are looking for passionate individuals who are eager to explore uncharted waters and contribute to our innovative projects.
 


**Position Overview** 
  


 We are looking for a Software Engineer to work at the forefront of deploying our cutting\-edge AI models, enhancing the performance and capabilities of our embodied systems. You will be responsible for optimizing AI inference processes from lightweight to billion\-parameter models, ensuring our robots operate with unmatched efficiency and intelligence in real\-world environments. You will work at the intersection of systems and machine learning, directly contributing to making our AI models more powerful and adaptive by ensuring consistent performance in light of variable and perhaps unforeseen compute and hardware constraints.
 


  

**Responsibilities** 
  

  
* Develop and optimize runtime AI inference pipelines for real\-world robotic deployment.
  
* Build infrastructure, frameworks, and tooling to enable reliable integration of models into robotic systems and informative analysis of production models to drive the direction of architecture choice and deployment system design.
  
* Formulate specialized optimization solutions for various inference paradigms and scenarios (autoregressive models, denoising models, hierarchical models, state machines, multi\-agent systems, cloud\-based inference).
  
* Adapt optimization solutions to various compute, hardware, and networking constraints.
  


  

**Preferred Qualifications** 
  

  
* BS, MS or higher degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  
* Minimum of 3 years of industry experience.
  
* Proficiency developing in low\-level systems languages (C, C\+\+, Rust, Go), Python and at least one deep learning library such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, etc.
  
* Deep understanding and practical experience with low\-level systems concepts (multithreading, networking, embedded systems, memory management).
  
* Experience with CUDA.
  
* Deep understanding of state\-of\-the\-art machine learning techniques and models.
  
* Experience optimizing various machine learning architectures.
  
* Experience with machine learning compilers.
  
* Experience optimizing model inference for robotic systems deployment.
